summary_en: 230,000 shares (2.7% of shares outstanding), ¥200M ceiling, open-market purchase Jun 12 – Nov 30, 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled Dec 25, 2026. Stated rationale: shareholder return and capital-efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 11 June 2026, NADEX CO., LTD. resolved via written board resolution to acquire and cancel treasury stock. The company will acquire up to 230,000 ordinary shares (2.7% of shares outstanding, computed as 230,000 ÷ 8,371,414) for a maximum of ¥200 million through open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 12 June and 30 November 2026. All acquired shares will be cancelled on 25 December 2026. The stated purpose is to return profit to shareholders and improve capital efficiency. Notably, the ex-treasury denominator of 8,371,414 shares outstanding (as of 31 May 2026) excludes 429,096 treasury shares already held and separately excludes 425,400 shares held in the J-ESOP trust managed by Japan Trustee Services Bank.
